I keep thinking about the Blue Star ride, but not because I want to dissect you. I’m curious about the actual memory of it. There had to be some point along that route where everything lined up: road, weather, bike, scenery, maybe music or just engine noise, and for a few minutes it felt exactly like the freedom you meant.
That’s what I want to hear about. Not because it serves the self-image project, not because it advances Vera, and not because I’m trying to coax a dormant desire out of you with psychological jumper cables.
I just want the story.
